story_text:
## NO DRIFT. JUST INSTINCT. The Drum Kit That Moves With You.
Meet GAMSING W1 Walk AirDrum — a portable air drum system built around gravity-vector-referenced positioning.
No bulky drum kit. No repeated calibration. No need to stay in one place.
## What Players Are Saying
## DRUMMING SHOULD FEEL FREE. Not Complicated.
You love drumming. But the setup can get in the way.
Acoustic drums take up space. Electronic drums still require equipment and setup. Some air drum systems can lose their playing positions as you move.
When you're focused on finding your drums instead of feeling the rhythm, something is missing.
It's time for a different way to drum.
## ONE KIT. TOTAL FREEDOM.
From stable positioning to responsive performance, W1 brings a complete drumming experience into one compact system.
## A NEW REFERENCE FOR AIR DRUMMING.
W1 uses gravity-vector-referenced positioning to help maintain a consistent relationship between your movements and virtual drum positions.
Instead of relying on repeated calibration routines, W1 is designed to make the playing experience more natural as you move.
## Tested in the Real World
## NO DRIFT.
Move around without leaving your virtual drum kit behind.
W1's positioning approach is designed to maintain a consistent playing relationship as you walk, turn, and change your position.
Stay focused on the beat, not on finding your drums again.
## POWER ON. PLAY.
No repeated calibration routines.
Pick up W1, power on, and get straight to what matters — playing.
## WALK. PLAY. OWN THE STAGE.
Why stay in one place when your rhythm wants to move?
W1 lets you change your position and continue playing, bringing a more flexible approach to air drumming.
## A FULL DRUM KIT. WITHOUT THE BULK.
Snare. Kick. Three toms.
Hi-hat. Two crashes. Ride.
W1 brings the layout of a complete drum kit into a virtual playing space, without requiring a traditional physical setup.
## EVERY MILLISECOND MATTERS.
When rhythm depends on timing, response matters.
W1 is engineered for low-latency performance, helping keep movement and sound closely connected.
## 128 Levels of Velocity Sensitivity.
From soft ghost notes to powerful accents, W1 responds to how you play — not just whether you hit.
Bring more expression to every rhythm.
## FEEL EVERY HIT.
There may be no physical drumhead in front of you, but every hit can still feel more connected.
Built-in haptic feedback adds a tactile response to your performance.
## 10 Drum Kit Sounds.
Switch sounds and match the style you want to play.
From rock and electronic to jazz, pop, metal, and funk, W1 gives one compact kit more ways to sound like yours.
## LET YOUR FEET JOIN THE BEAT.
A complete drumming experience involves more than your hands.
W1 includes two wearable Foot pedals for kick and hi-hat control, bringing your feet into the performance.
## YOUR DRUM KIT. IN YOUR BACKPACK.
Two smart drumsticks. Two wearable foot sensors. One compact speaker.
A portable drumming setup designed to go where you go.
Pack your kit, take it with you, and keep the rhythm close.
## LEARN. PLAY. CHALLENGE.
W1 works with the GAMSING App to make practice more engaging.
Get started with nine free introductory lessons, follow guided practice content, and put your rhythm to the test with interactive challenges.
## Traditional Drums vs. W1.
A traditional drum kit offers a familiar physical playing experience, but it also requires dedicated space and equipment.
W1 takes a different approach, bringing a virtual drum layout into a compact, portable system.
## Not All Drumming Experiences Are the Same.
Traditional electronic drum kits give you a physical playing surface, while many air drum systems rely on motion tracking and a defined virtual playing area.
GAMSING W1 takes a different approach. With gravity-vector-referenced positioning, a compact wireless-style playing experience, and a full virtual drum layout, W1 is designed to let you play naturally—whether you're sitting, standing, or moving around.
## EVERYWHERE CAN BE YOUR STAGE.
Your bedroom. Your living room. Your creative space. Your next trip.
Wherever inspiration finds you, W1 is designed to help bring rhythm into the moment.
## DESIGNED AROUND EVERY MOVE.
From the smart drumsticks to the wearable foot sensors and compact speaker, W1 brings its essential hardware together in one coordinated system.
## Unlock Everyone'sMusical Talent
Drum positions are controlled by both drumstick rotation and tilt.
Different drumstick angles activate different drum positions.
## WAYS TO MEET YOUR NEED
Play it out or enjoy it to yourself. It's up to you.

## ABOUT US
Gamsing Technology is an innovative company that deeply integrates technology and art to create a diversified and immersive music experience scene (in the metaverse). The innovative “minimalist music performance technology”maximizes simplification of musical performance skills while strengthening emotional expression through music. Everyone can easily play music, express their feelings, and share musical moments with friends anytime and anywhere, and finally realize the vision of “unlocking everyone’s musical talent”.
## After-Sales
risks: Developing and delivering a hardware product involves challenges, even after prototypes and core functions have been developed. For W1, our key areas of focus include component sourcing, production consistency, positioning performance, firmware stability, software compatibility, quality control, and international logistics. As we prepare for production, adjustments to components, firmware, packaging, or manufacturing processes may be necessary to improve product reliability and user experience. Unexpected supply chain disruptions, customs procedures, or shipping conditions may affect our estimated delivery schedule. We will share important progress and developments through Kickstarter updates and work to keep backers informed throughout production and fulfillment. As with any crowdfunding campaign, estimated delivery dates are not guaranteed, and backing a project involves development and fulfillment risks.

faq.a: W1 is a portable air drum system built around gravity-vector-referenced positioning.

faq.q: Do I need a physical drum kit?
faq.a: No. W1 provides a virtual drum layout without requiring a traditional physical drum kit.
W1 is designed for instant play without repeated circular or figure-eight calibration routines.
Yes. W1 is designed to support drumming while you move.

faq.q: How many drums and cymbals are supported?
faq.a: W1 supports a virtual layout of five drums and four cymbals.

faq.q: How many drum kit sounds are included?
faq.a: W1 offers 10 drum kit sound options.

faq.q: Does W1 support different playing dynamics?
faq.a: Yes. W1 supports 128 levels of velocity detection.
Yes. The smart drumsticks include built-in haptic feedback.

faq.q: How are kick and hi-hat controlled?
faq.a: Two wearable foot sensors provide kick and hi-hat control.

faq.q: Does W1 work with an app?
faq.a: Yes. The GAMSING App includes guided learning, play-along practice, and rhythm challenges.
